name: Classic Heraldry
note: Familiar corner layout · shared gold trim
direction: Closest extension of the approved menu, recommended baseline. Upper-left two slim straight resource bars in one compact dark navy plaque with gold clipped corners; small ivory heart/drop symbols to the left. Upper-right one restrained mission panel beneath a small outlined Menu button. Bottom-center four broad square heraldic skill tiles in a subtle continuous navy rail with generous key labels. Bottom-right compact square minimap, thin gold frame and separate serif header. The top-center Raphael seal is about 90 pixels in diameter. Short ivory region labels have a tiny gold diamond and nearly invisible dark underlay. Fine corners, readable action-game scale.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Create ONE polished full-screen 16:9 gameplay HUD design mockup for Blob to Blade.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the user's current gameplay screenshot, a turquoise slime in a pixel-art ruined camp. Preserve the exact pixel-art world, slime, pink-haired NPC, camera angle, lighting and terrain layout. Replace ONLY interface overlays. Input image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the approved Ivory Heraldry main menu/settings/icon family. Do not insert its logo, menu, board layout or settings screen into gameplay.
Make the whole gameplay interface belong to that approved family: ivory filled heraldic silhouettes with useful, recognizable meanings; warm restrained gold engraved borders; dark navy translucent backing; small cyan selection details; readable elegant Cinzel-like serif headings and clear compact numbers. Crisp restrained ornament, no generated visual clutter, no huge frames, no thick bevels, no chrome metal, no generic sci-fi interface, no heavy black dimming over the world. Keep central 65% of view unobstructed. This is a playable HUD, NOT a title card, NOT a poster or labeled design board. Show no design-name labels.
Redesign ALL visible interface elements together: HP and ICHOR top-left or as variant specifies; menu button; mission tracker; currency; 4 skill slots and key labels; minimap and its heading/key; small ambient region labels; top-center Raphael golden seal. Use the same deliberate stroke, corner treatment, icon style and typography across all elements. Retain Raphael's recognizable gold circular magic sigil, quietly glowing, compact at top-center. No giant new symbol in the middle of gameplay.
Exact readable HUD copy: "HP" "100 / 100"; "ICHOR" "1 / 100"; "MENU"; "I · RUINED OUTPOST"; "Find Shuna at Captain Camp"; small gold currency icon and "0"; skill keys "LMB" "RMB" "SPACE" "Q"; "REGION MAP" and "TAB"; ambient labels "RAIN DITCH" and "CAMP". Four skill symbols: crescent water slash, curling wave, swift dash streak, human transformation silhouette. Ivory/cyan consistent graphic symbols, dark slot faces. Preserve practical HUD information; health is crimson, Ichor is warm gold, active spells cyan. Minimal typography must remain readable over terrain.
Output one high quality landscape gameplay screenshot, close to 1920x1080.

Bottom-right compact square minimap, thin gold frame and separate serif header. The top-center Raphael seal is about 90 pixels in diameter. name: Crescent Crest
direction: Use a small ivory broken-arch/crescent/slime crest as a 60-pixel medallion anchoring the upper-left resource bars. Long clean HP/Ichor bars extend to its right with gold diamond endcaps. Crescent details echo the approved logo without showing a wordmark. Four separated subtly arched skill tiles bottom-center, ivory pictograms and cyan ready glow. Upper-right the quest is a compact navy hanging pennant with two tiny gold corner flourishes, Menu above it. Bottom-right circular cartographic minimap with thin ivory compass ticks and small gold frame, MAP/TAB below; keep readable terrain and markers. Raphael top-center, compact. All elements delicate and sparse, practical rather than ornate.

name: Moonlit Compass
direction: A balanced exploration-focused variation. Upper-right mission on one clean small navy scroll-shaped panel with gold hairline rails and an ivory four-point quest star, coin counter set beside the chapter label, small Menu above. Bottom-center four circular ability medallions containing substantial recognizable ivory/cyan symbols, each with a clean separate dark key tab; only the selected one has a faint cyan rim. Bottom-right octagonal minimap with restrained ivory compass tips and thin warm gold edging; square map content inset with clean clipping. Top-center Raphael gold seal slightly smaller than minimap, optional tiny 'RAPHAEL' serif label below. No stars scattered over the gameplay, no giant decorations.
